T: Rain on the rooftops. Breakfast in the flat.
D: A murdered musician returns from the dead a year later to avenge himself and his fiancée.
P: Serve the mains when Darla cooks Sarah a proper breakfast.
S: Buttered popcorn with black salt and a pinch of chilli flakes
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter, black salt and a pinch of chilli flakes, served in dark bowls by candlelight.
Buttered white bread filled with ham and cheddar, pan toasted
Thick white bread buttered on the outside, filled with cheddar and ham, grilled in a pan until golden and melting, cut into soldiers.
cocktail frankfurts in soft little buns under spiced beef chilli, yellow mustard and diced onion

Cocktail franks in soft little buns under a spiced beef chilli, with yellow mustard and finely diced white onion, Detroit style. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 finely diced onion, breaking it up well. Add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water, and simmer 20 minutes until thick and saucy. Simmer 16 cocktail frankfurts in water for 5 minutes. Tuck into 16 small soft rolls, spoon over the chilli and top with mustard and diced onion.
M: Darla's bacon and egg breakfast plate
Darla finally cooking breakfast for her daughter

Crisp bacon, sunny side up eggs, golden potato hash browns and thick buttered toast, a proper diner-style plate cooked with care. Grate 800g potatoes, squeeze very dry in a tea towel and mix with salt and 1 grated onion. Fry 8 flat cakes in oil and butter over medium heat for 5 minutes a side until crisp. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Fry 4 eggs sunny side up in butter. Toast 4 thick slices of bread and butter well. Plate it all up with tomato sauce on the side.
Beef meatloaf with a brown sugar tomato glaze
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash and gravy.
W: Blackberries under an oat and brown sugar crumble

Dark, jammy blackberries baked under a buttery oat and brown sugar crumble until bubbling, served hot with vanilla ice cream. Toss 750g blackberries with 80g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 100g plain flour, then stir in 80g rolled oats and 80g brown sugar. Scatter over the fruit. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 10 minutes and serve hot with scoops of vanilla ice cream.
K: Hot coffee, Irish whiskey and brown sugar

Hot strong coffee sweetened with brown sugar and spiked with Irish whiskey, under a thick layer of lightly whipped cream. Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out. Add 2 tsp brown sugar and 40ml Irish whiskey to each, then pour in 150ml hot strong coffee and stir until the sugar dissolves. Lightly whip 150ml cream until just thickened but still pourable. Pour it slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. For Sarah, make hot chocolate instead.

s.note: Buttered popcorn with black salt and a pinch of chilli flakes
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn, shaking often. Toss with 50g melted butter, a good pinch of black salt and a small pinch of chilli flakes. Serve in dark bowls by candlelight, the room lit only by the flicker.

s.note: Buttered white bread filled with ham and cheddar, pan toasted
s.how: Butter 8 slices of thick white bread on the outside. Fill 4 sandwiches with sliced cheddar and ham. Cook in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut each into long soldiers and serve hot.

m.note: Beef meatloaf with a brown sugar tomato glaze
